rationale: Lyc. abstract = Sah. ⲙⲛⲧⲥⲟϭ/ⲙⲛⲧⲥⲟⲃⲉ 'foolishness, folly.' Recurs lines 10, 26 of this page. Critical to distinguish from ⲙⲛⲧⲥⲁⲃⲉ ('wisdom') — context (becomes battle/war, opposed to Mind of Light) confirms negative valence. The vowel ⲉ (not ⲁ) after ⲥ marks the foolish-stem.

Tentative; possibly Lyc. for ⲧⲱⲃⲥ̄ 'urge, exhort, persuade.' Could alternatively render the embrace/communion of brothers. The sense 'what brothers offer that the apostate rejects' fits the ecclesiastical restoration framework. Flag for parallels.

Lyc. = Sah. ϩⲱⲣⲃ̄ 'lie in wait, lurk, fall short.' Used here of Wisdom's withdrawal — she goes into hiding rather than departing entirely. Manichaean motif: the light-faculty does not vanish but hides itself when sin reigns.

Tentative reading as Greek ἅλων 'threshing-floor' (= Coptic ϩⲁⲗⲱⲛ) with ⲣ for ⲗ and Lyc. possessive ⲡⲉϩ-. The threshing-floor as image of the church-community fits Manichaean agricultural typology. Alternative: a non-attested 'company/dwelling' noun. Flag for parallels in subsequent kephalaia.

proposed_english: to please / be pleasing to him
rationale: Lyc. = Sah. ⲣ̄-ϩⲛⲁ⸗ϥ̄ 'please, be agreeable to him.' Standard Coptic verbal idiom; here negated as the diagnostic sign of disaffection from the brotherhood.
Lyc. = Sah. ⲥⲟⲉⲓⲧ 'fame, report, rumor' with possessive ⲡⲉϩ-. The brother's reputation 'is scattered in the church' — bad-news circulation as ecclesiastical sign of apostasy.
ⲧⲣ̄ⲉ- (causative) + ⲣ̄-ⲙ̄ⲕⲁϩ 'be in pain, grieve' — 'cause grief.' The Lyc. contraction ⲑⲣ̄ⲕⲁϩ is unusual. Standard verb of inflicting suffering.
ⲡⲕⲱⲧ here = 'edification, building-up' of/by brothers — the constructive ecclesial activity. Distinct from 'building/structure' as cosmic edifice (also on this page line 29 'building of God').
Greek ἐπιτιμία 'rebuke, censure, punishment.' Standard NT/early Christian ecclesiastical discipline term. With ⲧⲙ̄-ⲭⲓ ('not receive') = refusing fraternal correction.

proposed_english: of a single sort / of one kind
rationale: ⲣⲙ̄- ('person of') + ⲛ̄- + ⲟⲩⲱⲧ ('one, single'). The apostate brother insists on 'food of a single kind' — refusing communal variety.
